device_entry.name: 可变控制针阀
tags: 真空系统与高真空实验
高真空/超高真空腔体与仪器配套
device_entry.description: 一种用于真空系统的可调针阀，用于连续控制两侧气体体积之间的流量，而不是仅进行全开或全关切换。常用于真空管路中的气体导入、抽气平衡或细致流量调节。
device_entry.description_en: An adjustable needle valve for vacuum systems that continuously controls flow between two gas volumes rather than simply switching fully open or closed. It is commonly used for gas dosing, pumping balance, or fine flow regulation in vacuum lines.
